{{Quote|I've seen dinosaurs, on Trammis III.|Arun Feb|<ref name="MoS">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]''</ref>}}
'''Trammis III''', or '''Trammis Three''',<ref name="MF">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref> also known simply as '''Trammis''',<ref name="SWR">[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']]</ref> was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Trammis system/Legends|Trammis system]] of the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]] region.

==History==
Trammis III was home to gigantic [[Reptile/Legends|reptilians]], sometimes referred to as [[Dinosaur/Legends|dinosaurs]], as noted by [[Arun Feb]] in his [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] game with [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]].<ref name="MoS" /> The most deadly of these was the [[akorec]], which attracted many tourists due to their link with modern-day dinosaurs. The first two teams of settlers who arrived on Trammis III were devoured by the akorec, and the third team almost wiped out the reptilians.

The planet was also the homeworld of [[Trammic mome]]s, whose warrens were vast networks of caves. [[Omo Bouri/Legends|Omo Bouri]] orchestrated the [[Treaty of Trammis]] on this world in [[124 BBY]]. Many xenoarchaeologists believed that Trammis III was a possible homeworld of the [[Sharu/Legends|Sharu]], since many [[Toka]] spoke a dialect of the [[Old High Trammic/Legends|Old High Trammic]] language.

==Behind the scenes==
The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Trammis III in the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]].<ref name="SWR" />
